mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT exec.*, dsp.dsp_slot_code AS dspSlotCode, ssp_slot.ssp_slot_id AS sspSlotId, media.media_company_short AS mediaCompany FROM dsp_input_exec AS exec LEFT JOIN dsp_slot_info AS dsp ON dsp.company_id = exec.company_id LEFT JOIN data_dsp_slot_day AS ssp_slot ON ssp_slot.dsp_slot_id = dsp.id AND ssp_slot.date = DATE_FORMAT(#{inputTime}, '%Y%m%d') LEFT JOIN ssp_slot_info AS ssp ON ssp.id = ssp_slot.ssp_slot_id LEFT JOIN ssp_media AS media ON media.id = ssp.media_id WHERE exec.input_time = DATE_FORMAT(#{inputTime}, '%Y%m%d') AND exec.company_id = #{id} ORDER BY exec.id DESC
